Skenario Pengujian: Positif: Uji H₀: μ(jk = 1) − μ(jk = 2) = δ₀ dengan kovarians sama
Langkah Pengujian: 1. Impor hotelling 2 populasi independen.csv. 2. Analyze → General Linear Model → Multivariate. DV x1, x2, x3, x4; Fixed Factor(s): jk. 3. Covariance Matrices: Equal (Pooled estimate of Σ). 4. Klik "Test Values (δ₀)"; isi 3, 2, 10, 1 → Continue. 5. Options: Descriptive Statistics, Homogenity Tests → Continue. 6. OK. 7. Ulangi pada mv2-geser.csv dengan δ₀ = 0.
Hasil yang Diharapkan: Subdialog berjudul "Test Values (δ₀) — Hotelling T² Dua Populasi" menampilkan "H₀: μ(jk = 1) − μ(jk = 2) = δ₀" dan satu isian per DV. Catatan Multivariate Tests memuat "H₀: μ(jk = 1) − μ(jk = 2) = δ₀, δ₀ = [3, 2, 10, 1]. Computed on data in which δ₀ is subtracted from every observation with jk = 1; the jk effect tests this hypothesis." Nilai Multivariate Tests dan Tests of Between-Subjects Effects sama dengan langkah 7 dan dengan SPSS (spss/mv2_delta0.sps). Descriptive Statistics sama dengan data asli (jk = 1, x1: Mean 15.9688).
